feat(opencode): port provider to @opencode/client 2.4.2 (plan 219 phase 2)

Replace @opencode-ai/sdk with exact-pinned @opencode/client 2.4.2. Managed
mode spawns a private opencode serve (explicit pipes, startup-timeout kill,
continuous draining); external mode authenticates from OPENCODE_PASSWORD /
OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD; verify() gates on MIN_OPENCODE_VERSION 2.4.2 in
both modes, and the factory closes the provider on verify failure through
the OpenCodeFactoryDeps seam.

The turn loop owns exactly one msg_5x prompt: in-flight guard and busy
precheck, single admission with evidence-based reconciliation, delivery-gated
settlement through settleTurn on the streamed and polled paths, bounded
unknown state, window-scoped usage that fails closed, and owned cleanup
(exact-id inbox cancel with re-cancel; interrupt only on the managed private
server). Prompted structured output uses a new string-aware top-level
extractor with two corrective turns. The event mapper is rewritten for 2.x.

Opt-in live test added. Managed and authenticated external cases pass on
OpenCode 2.4.2; the question deny-or-cancel case is inconclusive because the
headless question deny removes the tool from the session (see run notes).

result_json.reason: Phase 2 is implemented and committed (4f91b494). Every gate item passes except one live case, which cannot pass as the contract defines it. Passing: unit tests, typecheck, build, the full suite (4424 pass, 0 fail), SDK removal, and both live provider cases (managed and authenticated external) on opencode v2.4.2, which equals MIN_OPENCODE_VERSION. The failing case is the question deny-or-cancel live case. The contract passes it only on a question tool call that ends in a denied tool_end, or on a form.cancel fallback, and calls anything else inconclusive. Live probes on 2.4.2 show that the headless deny rule {action: question, effect: deny} removes the question tool from the session entirely: the model cannot call it, and it only ran execute/search calls looking for it. So no question tool call and no form ever occur, and the case always reports inconclusive. The deny does stop forms, so the fallback was not implemented. Without the deny, question raises form.created, and cancelling that form interrupts the whole execution (reason shutdown) instead of letting the turn continue. Operator decision needed, through a contract amendment: accept a control-proven 'tool unavailable' path for this case (the same prompt on a test-owned session without the deny produces form.created; the provider's session settles with no question call and no form), or redefine or drop the case. Two Phase 2 checkboxes stay unchecked until then: the live question case and the live-test pass.
result_json.notes:
Design choices not covered by the plan:
(1) An internal timings seam (4th constructor arg) scales the 10 s bounds down for unit tests, and createExternal gained internal fetch and env seams, so unit tests need no network or process.env changes.
(2) A declared (tagged) server error on session.prompt is treated as a definite rejection, not a lost reply, and fails at once with no reconciliation.
(3) run() rethrows the typed error behind runStreamed's error event, so AgentTimeoutError and AgentCancellationError keep their types.
(4) Three consecutive failed polls surface as an error.
(5) The live test is registered only when FIVEX_OPENCODE_LIVE=1, matching the repo's existing live-test convention.
(6) A mutation check confirmed the ownership and unknown-state tests fail when that logic is broken.

items.reason: During lost-admission polling the pump can buffer a foreign enqueue/delivery before our delivery, text, and success. introducedBy.explanation: The new EventPump buffers ownership and content events while the turn awaits a read, allowing one drain batch to cross the overlap and delivery boundaries. items.title: Remove the implied stop-on-form production policy
items.reason: Design Decisions says the provider never continues past a form, but the same design and §2.3 specify no AgentEvent or cancellation for a matching form and retain normal settlement and cleanup. The authorized amendment removes the fallback; it does not define a new terminal policy.
items.failure: An implementer can read the shared design as requiring an unapproved early exit for a resumed or unexpectedly interactive session.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Delete the unconditional never-continues clause. State that there is no cancel-and-continue fallback, leave §2.3 handling unchanged, and retain live-gate failure on a deny-arm form.

items.title: Require complete raw observation for the deny arm
items.reason: The live-only raw subscription opens when consumed and has no replay. Section 2.6 does not require confirmed readiness or coverage through the deny execution's terminal event, and the provider can produce done via polling without surfacing forms.
items.failure: A passing control followed by a late, disconnected, or undrained raw observer can falsely turn a missed question call or form into proof of denial.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Consume the raw stream and await server.connected before either prompt. Require uninterrupted consumption through the matching deny execution's raw terminal event and fail as inconclusive on a gap or missing terminal evidence within the bound; also require provider done with no error.
